faq.q: How do BC's SSMUH rules apply in Abbotsford?
faq.a: Under the SSMUH amendment (Bylaw No. 3560-2024, adopted June 25, 2024), accessory units count toward up to 4 units on one lot in SSMUH areas — 3 units on lots 280 m² or less, 4 units on lots bigger than 280 m² — with secondary suites (within the principal unit, registered, under 50% of its size) and garden suites / coach houses (up to 15% of the lot to a maximum of 100 m²) as the accessory forms.

faq.q: How did the plan areas' part of Abbotsford sell in September 2026?
faq.a: No plan-area figures exist in the permitted source. At board sub-area level, Central Abbotsford (containing the City Centre, Historic Downtown and UDistrict plan areas) recorded 70 detached listings with 12 sold (17%) and 256 Condos & Townhomes listings with 35 sold (14%), and Abbotsford East (containing the McKee plan area) recorded 165 detached listings with 15 sold (9%) and 69 attached listings with 4 sold (6%); whole-city medians were $949,000 detached and $497,500 attached — sub-area and city context only, not plan-area figures (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats FVR/GVR September 2026 report).
